messages.content: Give me the MTBI of my friend.

function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content:
Sure! To get started, I’ll need a bit more insight into your friend’s typical behaviors and preferences. Could you share:

1. How does your friend usually make decisions—do they rely heavily on logic & facts (thinking) or personal values & feelings (feeling)?
2. When faced with new situations, does your friend prefer having clear plans ahead (judging) or staying flexible and open-ended (perceiving)?
3. In group settings, does your friend tend to engage actively and talk openly (extraverted), or reflect internally before speaking (introverted)?

Feel free to describe specific scenarios or habits—they don’t have to be exhaustive. Once I’ve got those clues, I can help infer which MBTI dimensions might fit best.
